title: Tracekit Box: Running AI Agents in Micro-VMs Where Every Way Out Is Decided and Signed
abstract: arXiv:2610.38458v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents now install packages, call model APIs with their operators' keys and change code in repositories that deploy to production. The network, credentials and write access they need are also how they can leak data, steal a key or change a system nobody approved. Sandboxes contain an agent but leave little evidence of what crossed their boundary; tracing records what happened but contains nothing. We present Tracekit Box, an open-source system (MIT, v0) that does both. Each job runs in its own Firecracker micro-VM with no network card. The only ways out are doors on the host, served over vsock: commands, outbound connections, secrets, model calls and the workspace patch. At every door a Tracekit signer the agent cannot reach decides what passes and signs it into one run per box. Names are resolved on the host; private and cloud-metadata addresses are always refused; secrets never enter the VM, which sees placeholders the host proxy

translated_title: Tracekit Box：在每个出口都被决策并签名的微型虚拟机中运行 AI 智能体
translated_abstract: AI 智能体现在可以安装软件包、使用运营者的密钥调用模型 API，并修改部署到生产环境的仓库中的代码。它们所需的网络、凭据和写权限，同时也是它们泄露数据、窃取密钥或擅自更改未经批准系统的途径。沙箱可以约束智能体，但对越过其边界的内容几乎不留下任何证据；追踪系统记录了发生了什么，却无法阻止任何事。我们提出了 Tracekit Box，一个开源系统（MIT 许可证，v0 版本），能够同时做到两者。每个任务运行在自己的 Firecracker 微型虚拟机中，该虚拟机没有网卡。唯一的外出途径是宿主机上通过 vsock 提供服务的“门”：命令执行、出站连接、密钥、模型调用和工作区补丁。在每一道门前，一个智能体无法触及的 Tracekit 签名器决定放行什么，并将其签名记录到每个盒子的一次运行日志中。域名解析在宿主机上完成；私有地址和云元数据地址总是被拒绝；密钥永远不会进入虚拟机，虚拟机只能看到宿主机代理提供的占位符……
tldr: Tracekit Box 是一个开源系统，它将 AI 智能体运行在无网卡的 Firecracker 微型虚拟机中，所有出口通道（命令、出站连接、密钥、模型调用、代码补丁）均由智能体无法触及的宿主机签名器统一决策、放行并签名留痕，从而同时实现安全沙箱与完整的可审计性。
en_tdlr: Tracekit Box is an open-source system that runs AI agents in network-less Firecracker micro-VMs, where every exit path—commands, outbound connections, secrets, model calls, and workspace patches—is decided and signed by a host-side signer the agent cannot reach, combining sandboxing with cryptographic auditability.
